subject: Community Survey Design and Charter Review Outreach
overview: The committee reviewed feedback from its first public event and extensively debated the structure and content of a forthcoming community survey. Members also coordinated upcoming interviews with city officials and planned neighborhood outreach events for the summer.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: June 8 Event Review and Committee Vacancies
items.summary: Members discussed logistical improvements for future events, including camera angles and microphone usage, and recommended asking the Mayor to fill vacancies from the original candidate pool.

items.title: Outreach Strategies and Focus Groups
items.summary: The committee discussed forming focus groups to track specific themes and identified diverse neighborhood locations, such as fire stations and pastry shops, for future meetings.

items.title: Community Survey Development
items.summary: The committee debated the length and phrasing of the community survey, deciding to remove introductory sections and add a ranking section for priority issues. A revised draft will be prepared for a vote at the next meeting.

items.title: Interview Status and Scheduling
items.summary: Members provided updates on interviews with the Mayor and city councilors while discussing outreach to department heads and former city officials.

items.title: Events, Communications, and Future Planning
items.summary: The committee coordinated plans for summer events, announced the launch of a Facebook page, and requested that members submit brief biographies for the city website.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: A resident provided suggestions on survey methodology, emphasizing the need for direct questions and expanded committee membership.

items.title: Election Data Project and Adjournment
items.summary: The committee noted progress on a historical election data project and scheduled the next meeting for July 6.
